item.title: Iron Fire Utah: 24,000 Acres and 0% Contained
item.description:
In just three days, the Iron Fire in Utah exploded from roughly 1,000 acres to more than 24,000 acres — and as of Monday afternoon, it was still 0% contained. That’s not a typo. A blaze that started Friday night has already torn across three counties and pushed an entire town out of its homes.

If you’re trying to understand what’s happening near Eureka, Utah right now, here’s the clearest, source-based breakdown of the Iron Fire.

item.title: Fire Near Me: Essential Guide to Tracking Wildfires and Staying Safe in 2026
item.description:
From a massive 4,176-acre blaze tearing through Moreno Valley to a deadly house fire in Rowan County and a U-Haul storage facility burning for the second time in Milwaukee — April 2026 is already proving that fire season doesn’t wait for summer.

If you’ve ever typed “fire near me” into a search bar, you’re not alone. It’s one of the most searched safety queries in the United States, and for good reason. Knowing where fires are burning — and how close they are to you — can mean the difference between a calm evening and an emergency evacuation.
